title: Kulan Assistant
description: Private writing help for selected text, summaries in Files, Translate and Explain after Live Text, and search with questions. Runs on this computer
size: about 40 MB, plus a model of 1.8 to 5 GB
note: Choose and download a model in Kulan Settings > Assistant.

title: Office and media apps
description: Writer, Calc and Impress (LibreOffice), VLC and GIMP

title: Chromium
description: A second web browser for sites that work best in Chrome-type browsers: the open-source browser Chrome is built from, from Debian, without Google's tracking. Kulan's privacy settings apply to it
note: Open Chromium from the app grid. Firefox stays your default browser; to change it, go to Settings > Apps > Default Apps. Netflix and other protected videos don't play in Chromium.

title: Developer Kit
description: Git, Python with pip and virtual environments, build tools, Docker and Docker Compose, curl
note: To use Docker without sudo, run: sudo usermod -aG docker $USER, then sign out and in again.

title: Kulan Fleet (for IT admins)
description: Look after an organisation's computers from this one: who needs updates, policies (updates, firewall, encryption, screen lock), installed apps, alerts and an activity log, and lock, restart or erase a lost computer
note: Open Kulan Fleet from your apps and sign in with your work email: it sends you a one-time code. Computers join your organisation from Kulan Settings › About.

title: Virus scanner
description: ClamAV with a simple app (ClamTk) to scan files, folders and USB drives on demand, useful for files from Windows computers

title: Phone Link
description: Connect your Android phone: notifications, texts, shared clipboard, files and media controls (GSConnect, works with the KDE Connect app)
note: Install KDE Connect on your phone. After you log out and back in, pair it from Phone Link in the top bar.

title: Nearby Share
description: Send files to nearby phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi, like AirDrop (LocalSend: iPhone, Android, Mac and Windows)
note: Install LocalSend on your other devices too, then open it on both.

title: Learning Pack
description: Tools for learning network and system defence: Wireshark and tcpdump to see network traffic, Nmap to check your own network, YARA and The Sleuth Kit for malware and forensics practice, TestDisk to recover files, a hex editor, and DNS, traceroute and whois tools
note: To capture network traffic without sudo, run: sudo dpkg-reconfigure wireshark-common (choose Yes), then sudo usermod -aG wireshark $USER, then sign out and in again. Only scan networks you own or have permission to test.

title: Steam
description: Valve's game store and launcher, with Proton to play many Windows games, from Flathub
size: about 1 GB from Flathub, plus your games
note: Open Steam from the app grid and sign in. In Steam > Settings > Compatibility, turn on Steam Play to run Windows games.
